core: Fibroblast control of fibrotic connective tissue repair
name: Fibroblast migration and matrix assembly in fibrotic repair
rationale: Members regulate fibroblast survival, migration, myofibroblast differentiation, ECM/collagen assembly and connective tissue replacement in wound fibrosis; unlike confusables it includes fibroblast migration and lacks their SMAD/miRNA and matrix-disassembly terms.

name: Organic ion transport with carnitine and choline metabolism
rationale: Members concern SLC organic cation/anion and carboxylate transport (incl. renal proximal tubule) together with carnitine and choline synthesis and catabolism, which the monocarboxylate and TCA-intermediate transport confusables lack.

name: RET and endothelin signaling in enteric nervous system development
rationale: Members cover GDNF/RET and endothelin signaling, neural crest migration, midgut/enteric neuron development and peristalsis, plus endothelin vascular effects that the GI smooth-muscle and sympathetic/catecholamine confusables lack.

core: Stalled ribosome rescue and mRNA surveillance decay
name: Stalled ribosome rescue in no-go and non-stop decay
rationale: Members concern rescue and PELO:HBS1L/ABCE1 dissociation of stalled cytosolic ribosomes with no-go/non-stop mRNA decay, distinct from NMD/polyadenylation, translation initiation and RQC/stress-granule confusables.

name: Catecholamine reuptake and synaptic vesicle loading
rationale: Members cover norepinephrine/dopamine/epinephrine uptake by SLC6A2/SLC6A3 and their defects plus vesicular loading and lumen acidification, which the general catecholamine transport, biosynthesis, degradation and serotonin confusables lack.

name: Telomerase telomere lengthening, replicative senescence and lifespan
rationale: Members concern telomerase holoenzyme assembly, recruitment and telomere extension tied to replicative senescence, proliferation and lifespan, which the telomere capping, C-strand synthesis and Cajal-body confusables lack.

name: Left-right asymmetry determination by Nodal signaling
rationale: Members cover left-right axis specification in organs and lateral mesoderm with nodal cilium movement and Nodal signaling regulation, distinguishing it from motile-cilia, gastrulation and ligand-sequestration confusables.

qualifier: nucleic acid sensing by TLRs, RIG-I and cGAS-STING
name: Nucleic acid sensor-driven type I interferon antiviral response
rationale: Members cover innate antiviral nucleic-acid sensing (TLR3/7/8/9, RIG-I/MDA5, cGAS-STING, AIM2) and type I/III interferon production and response, distinguishing it from virus-host interaction, T-cell and TRIF/TAK1 confusables.

core: Fatty acid elongation and peroxisomal oxidation
name: Fatty acid elongation, peroxisomal oxidation and ether lipid synthesis
rationale: Members cover very-long/long/medium-chain fatty acid elongation and peroxisomal alpha/beta-oxidation (incl. ALD) plus plasmalogen, ether and wax synthesis, which the cholesterol/peroxisome-import, omega-oxidation and NAD/malonyl confusables lack.

core: MHC class I antigen processing and presentation
name: MHC class I antigen presentation and cross-presentation
rationale: Members cover class I peptide loading, cytosol-to-ER transport and phagosomal/endosomal cross-presentation of exogenous antigen, unlike MHC class II, proteasome-assembly and viral MHC-downregulation confusables.

name: Chemokine receptor-driven dendritic cell migration and maturation
rationale: Members cover chemokines and receptors (CCR1/7), leukocyte adhesion and chemotaxis with dendritic cell chemotaxis, maturation and survival, distinguishing it from lymphocyte-homing, monocyte and integrin confusables.

name: Hedgehog ligand autoprocessing and release in head development
rationale: Members concern Hh precursor autoproteolysis, palmitoylation defects, ERAD and release together with anterior head, neurocranium and diaphragm morphogenesis, unlike confusables centred on SMO/GLI signaling, protein lipidation and Notch glycosylation.

qualifier: endothelial shear stress and SRF actin targets
name: Endothelial shear-stress response and SRF actin targets
rationale: Members are SRF-driven actin/contractile target modules and endothelial laminar/oscillatory shear-stress PIEZO1 signaling; each confusable has only one of these halves plus smooth muscle or eNOS terms.

name: Epithelial-mesenchymal signaling in salivary branching and limb budding
rationale: Members concern reciprocal epithelial-mesenchymal signaling regulating salivary gland branching, epithelial/mesenchymal proliferation and limb bud formation, unlike lung, prostate, pancreas and other gland confusables.

name: Glomerular mesangium and nephron tubule segment development
rationale: Members cover development of glomerular mesangium/endothelium and proximal, distal, loop of Henle and collecting-duct segments plus filtration, unlike early nephrogenesis/ureteric bud and podocyte confusables.

name: Fructose and polyol metabolism and its inherited disorders
rationale: Members cover fructose catabolism with essential fructosuria and hereditary fructose intolerance plus alditol synthesis/breakdown, unlike pentose, gluconeogenic and glycerol confusables.

core: Viral RNA replication and translation in host cells
qualifier: mRNA capping and evasion of IFIT and PKR
name: Viral RNA capping, translation and host effector evasion
rationale: Members cover coronavirus genome replication, mRNA cap methylation, viral translation and evasion of IFIT, PKR and host RNA processing, unlike influenza/RSV replication and SARS replicase confusables.

name: Glycerophospholipid biosynthesis and acyl-chain remodeling
rationale: Members cover synthesis of PC, PE, PS, PG and cardiolipin and their acyl-chain remodeling, unlike sphingolipid and lysophospholipid-hydrolysis confusables.

core: Nuclear pore complex and nuclear envelope dynamics
name: Nuclear pore transport and mitotic nuclear envelope remodeling
rationale: Members cover NPC assembly, transport through the pore (IPs, Rev, ribosomal subunits) and mitotic envelope disassembly, ESCRT-III sealing and reformation, which the SUMOylation, mRNA export and chromosome condensation confusables lack.

core: Type I interferon induction and response
qualifier: negative regulation incl. TREX1 and cGAS-STING restraint
name: Type I interferon induction and response with negative regulation
rationale: Members cover IRF3-driven type I IFN induction, IFN-alpha/beta responses and OAS, with negative regulation of IFN-beta, cGAS-STING and type I IFN signaling (TREX1), unlike sensor-focused RIG-I, TLR7/9 and broad antiviral confusables.

qualifier: vesicle endocytic recycling and active zone
name: Synaptic vesicle cycle from docking to endocytic recycling
rationale: Members cover vesicle docking, priming, SNARE assembly, fusion and transmitter-specific release cycles plus vesicle endocytosis, recycling and active zone maintenance, which the presynaptic-modulation and postsynaptic receptor-trafficking confusables lack.

name: Two-pore domain potassium leak channels and resting potential
rationale: Members are TWIK, TREK, TASK, THIK and TRESK K2P channels and resting membrane potential regulation, unlike TALK/TRP sour-taste, Ca-activated/Kir/voltage-gated K+ and pain confusables.

qualifier: type III interferon and chemokine induction
name: Type III and alpha interferon responses with chemokine induction
rationale: Members cover IFN-alpha and type III interferon production and response, OAS and cytosolic DNA sensing with CCL5, IP-10 and STAT6 chemokine induction, which distinguishes it from broader type I IFN, GBP and T-cell confusables.

name: Lysosomal glycosaminoglycan and glycoconjugate degradation
rationale: Members cover lysosomal breakdown of GAGs (mucopolysaccharidoses), oligosaccharides, gangliosides and sialic acid with their storage disorders, unlike GAG biosynthesis/glycosylation and N-glycan/UDP-GlcNAc synthesis confusables.

name: Phenylalanine and tyrosine catabolism
rationale: All members concern phenylalanine and tyrosine metabolism and catabolism including phenylketonuria, unlike threonine, glycine and histidine catabolism confusables.
